WITH account_counts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM Accounts AS a
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
    JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> ''
    GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
), town_totals AS (
    SELECT town_city, SUM(transaction_count) AS town_transaction_count
    FROM account_counts
    GROUP BY town_city
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(transaction_count * 1.0) AS avg_transaction_count
    FROM account_counts
)
SELECT ac.account_id,
       ac.town_city,
       ac.transaction_count,
       ac.transaction_count * 1.0 / tt.town_transaction_count AS town_transaction_share,
       ac.transaction_count * 1.0 / oa.avg_transaction_count AS ratio_to_average
FROM account_counts AS ac
JOIN town_totals AS tt ON tt.town_city = ac.town_city
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
